exact_definition: At lower_accepted, count issued-mask overlap with another live RO entry for same line; ready bits are not subtracted from the other issued mask.
pending_mask_definition: issued & ~ready is separately used by pending/lower-concurrency logic.
scope_boundaries: Counter1 cannot alone establish a simultaneously outstanding duplicate DRAM request because a live other entry can be ready/draining.
This does not prove the observed application event was only ready/draining: its event-level cause remains UNKNOWN.
Do not relabel1 as0 or claim universal same-address ownership correctness from it.
Original accepted results and all raw counters remain unchanged.
